steps.speaker: hale
steps.text: Technician. That glowing junk is Static: signal the burst scrambled. Left-click it to pop it.
steps.praise: See the bright gem it dropped? That is a data bit, the clean signal hiding inside.

steps.speaker: hale
steps.text: Pop these three. Every piece of Static is hiding bits.

steps.speaker: hale
steps.text: Now SWEEP. Hold the RIGHT mouse button over the bits to suck them into your tank.
steps.text_toggle: Now SWEEP. Right-click near the bits to start your vacuum, then move over them.

steps.speaker: hale
steps.text: SORT: let go of the right button over the RED chute. Red bits go in red. The chutes feed the Compressor, which CRUNCHES bits into data packets for Home Base.
steps.text_toggle: SORT: right-click over the RED chute to drop them. The chutes feed the Compressor, which CRUNCHES bits into data packets for Home Base.
steps.praise: That is a packet. Home Base pays for every one.

steps.speaker: hale
steps.text: That is the job. Pop, sweep, sort, crunch. Keep the Relay Chain open: the shift clock is running now.

steps.speaker: hale
steps.text: End of the shift. Your packets went up the Relay Chain. This is what you earned.

steps.speaker: hale
steps.text: Home Base writes after every shift. Every reply gives you something AND costs you something. Read the fine print, pick one, then continue.

steps.speaker: hale
steps.text: This is the skill tree: every upgrade lives here. Click Pop Power I to buy it. New nodes appear as you buy the ones next to them. Bought by mistake? Undo tonight.

steps.speaker: hale
steps.text: Spend the rest how you like. When you are ready, start Day 2.

tips.text: Blue Static: tougher, 4 clicks, but it drops 3 bits. Blue bits go in the BLUE chute.
Green Static splits into small Static when popped. Pop the pieces too.
Wrong chute. Bits only go down the chute of their own color (Gold bits fit any chute).
Tank full. Sort them before you sweep more. Tank Size in the tree holds more.
Last call! Get your bits into a chute. Bits left on the floor are lost tonight.
Bits left on the floor are lost. Night Storage in the Signal branch keeps them.
A drone. It carries loose bits to the right chute for you.
Universal Chute. One chute for every color. No more sorting.
Open Channel: some mail now has an extra reply. The pink one speaks to the Static.
GOLD Static: rare, and it runs from you. Pop it for a pile of bits that fit any chute.
Mash SHIELD! Extra time on me.

nudges: The Static will not pop itself.
Clock is ticking. Well. It will be.
